notes.title: RESISTOR joins The Storyteller's Festival 2024
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello my friends, [/h3]

Today we’re happy to announce that [i][b]RESISTOR[/b][/i] has been selected to feature in [b]The Storyteller’s Festival 2024[/b], a special Steam event highlighting the very best in narrative focused games organised by the kind folks at [b]Two and a Half Studios.[/b] You can check out the full line up of featured games [url= https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TheStorytellersFestival2024 ]HERE[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232333/33e7fbbc297446866f4bc514a6cda34ba9f82f3d.png[/img]

To celebrate we thought we’d share some more details on how we’ll be approaching storytelling in our CARPG.

[h3][b]The Great Divide - Types of exploration[/b][/h3]

When you're not earning high scores on the track, you'll have plenty of opportunity to explore the world of RESISTOR in your custom ride, discovering numerous settlements and interacting with the communities that inhabit them to propel the story forwards. Essentially your experience will be split between turbocharged racing in the open-world and more thoughtful on-foot exploration in these more contained areas. One such settlement is ‘The Rig’ a disused oil platform that acts as the focal point for the first area of the map, The Northern Wastes.   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232333/cd641dce5b5783c1145499995a33868d88b097a3.jpg[/img]

The central narrative in RESISTOR is built around multiple branching storylines that will intersect and change depending on how Aster interacts with the various characters and citizens encountered in the settlements. You’ll be able to recruit drivers and staff to your team, learn more about the history of the world, and undertake side missions to boost your growing reputation. 

[h3][b]Telling The Story - Types of interactions[/b][/h3]

NPC interactions are presented through cinematic mini-scenes that are fully voiced for an extra level of immersion.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232333/69b4d123711e2f10abdc5caa60479d4c0d567ce1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232333/0e3ced0453fe8487b3b03ab460952dc39920dd90.png[/img]

Often, these interactions will involve helping the locals and communities of the wastes. For example, the kids hanging out in the playground on ‘The Rig’ would love to see Aster perform a corkscrew just like their hero, Turbo Taylor. Head back out into the sands, complete the trick, and Aster will have gained a few new adoring fans.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232333/32184d76d9ae3ec46d2cf73e97ada62aa17602ee.gif[/img]

Other interactions might require Aster to make a choice which, depending on Aster's decisions, may have serious consequences that could change the story's trajectory…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232333/5e27f2a46b7c7d25dd07631e86e04d6a046e1c2b.gif[/img]

These consequences could drastically alter the course of Aster's tale, leading to some dramatic twists and unexpected turns later down the line (but ssshhhh we didn’t tell you that!). 

That’s all for today, rest assured though we’ll be back with another update soon.

Thanks as always for the continued support.

Long Way Home & PQube

notes.title: First Look Gameplay Trailer Revealed!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hi all, how have you been?[/h3]

Today we are excited to reveal our [b]First Look Gameplay Trailer[/b] as seen at the [b]41st Golden Joystick Awards![/b]

In this new trailer we demonstrate how RESISTOR blends cinematic, character-driven storytelling with high-speed, stunt-infused racing as rising star Aster comes face to face with a dangerous pair of adversaries…   

We also introduce [b]character and vehicle customisation[/b], with an alternative look Aster, voiced by Thomas G Burt, jumping behind the wheel of several heavily modified refits of the R180 'STAGNUM' as it blazes across busy desert highways, threads the needle through a sprawling industrial complex, and navigates twisting subterranean tunnels.

[previewyoutube=edHR4UzN4yY;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232333/85efb2448382d5dac2869ecc89214970a5c98b47.jpg[/img]

[h3]A LEGEND IN THE MAKING[/h3]

Utilise the [b]character creator[/b] to design your own racing prodigy, Aster. In true RPG fashion choose from a wide selection of body shapes, facial features, hairstyles, skin tones, and accessories, with MILLIONS of different combinations possible! Once you’ve settled on your look, pick out an appropriate voice type, with feminine and masculine vocal talents courtesy of Rhiannon Moushall (Warframe, CrisTales, Cloudpunk) and Thomas G Burt (SMITE, The Prince of Tennis, Phoenix Point).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232333/f7932cab513d5eb50d777282275ed7890068c9a5.gif[/img]

[h3]CUSTOM RIDE[/h3]

Retrofitted with a finely tuned, high-performance (and slightly unstable), Star Point Motors GT1200 plasma engine, Aster’s iconic red and white first-generation R180 was inherited from their father, the legendary racer Eugene Aster. While this powerful machine provides the perfect entry point for fledgling racers participating in the early stages of Dekker’s tournament, later challenges may require more ‘specialised’ hardware. [b]Collect new body kits and engine parts to modify the appearance and handling of your ride[/b] before hitting the track to dominate your rivals. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232333/326e60a948649f5cabb0dc13a98637b303cc0cc2.gif[/img]

[h3]RACING ON THE EDGE[/h3]

Aster’s road to victory begins in [b]The Northern Wastes[/b], a sparsely populated desert expanse littered with remnants of the old world and characterised by dusty highways, monolithic mesas, and treacherous gulleys. At the centre of these badlands stands ‘The Rig’, a decommissioned oil platform home to a small community of outcasts and traders. Here you will [b]accept your first missions[/b] allowing you to get to grips with the basics of stunt-racing and open-world exploration, while simultaneously making a name for yourself and [b]building up your rep[/b]. As Aster progresses through Dekker’s tournament new areas of the world will become available to explore, with increasingly more technical environments and tracks to tame!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232333/cd641dce5b5783c1145499995a33868d88b097a3.jpg[/img]

We hope you enjoy this first look, and we'll be back for another update soon!

Long Way Home & PQube

notes.title: Announcing RESISTOR!
notes.notes:
[h3]A turbocharged narrative-driven adventure RPG featuring open-world exploration, stunt-infused racing, and explosive vehicular combat![/h3]

Build up your team and unravel a twisting story as you compete to take down an oppressive mega-corporation and its enigmatic director.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232333/088c810112861fea589e1ba0cccce5d8bdfc40a6.png[/img]

Check out our Announcement Trailer, as seen at the [b]Future Games Show Summer Showcase:[/b]

[previewyoutube=lWakjmurSRg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]The story so far…[/h3]

In the year 2060 the world’s governments have long since destroyed one another and in their place stand self-contained city states presided over by a league of powerful corporations. Within the walls of these dense urban metropolises, citizens enjoy a life of comfort and excess, far removed from the harsh realities of the scattered communities that scrape a living in the endless desert wastes of the outside world.  

To remain “competitive but friendly”, the corporations take turns hosting an annual racing tournament for the masses setting the finest teams, and bravest challengers, against one another in a series of exhilarating, high-speed death races. The ultimate prize? A one-way ticket to permanent citizenship, and a better life, inside the cities.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232333/8963f72396bd2478c2b4cc634698c7d5125039d1.gif[/img]

[h3]Desert Flower[/h3]

Play as Aster, the only living child of the last great racer, who enters this year’s event sponsored by Dekker Industries with the goal of securing the vital healthcare needed to save their ailing mother. However, as the tournament unfolds, Aster soon realises that life beneath the glossy veneer of Ethan Dekker’s corporate utopia might not be as idyllic as it initially seems, and a race for the podium soon becomes a war to overthrow his oppressive regime. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232333/d83c7880f54d614574f3ee7f456c6bca42254a10.jpg[/img]

[h3]Lowlifes in High Places[/h3]

As one of the seven great corporations, tech giant Dekker Industries can trace its lineage back to the old days of the now defunct oil industry. The company currently oversees the activities of many subsidiaries within the confines of its steel-clad bastion, including the famous Diamond Motors. Its figurehead, Ethan Dekker (voiced by Mark Meer) is a consummate showman, and self-proclaimed ‘man of the people’, who relishes the prestige of hosting this year’s racing tournament. Yet behind his warm words and charismatic persona, lies the cold heart of a shrewd and ruthless businessman.   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232333/8bcfc6e5eef06cab4a4333231edac690bcb36175.gif[/img]

[h3]Start your Plasma-Engines[/h3]   

The annual racing tournament was initially conceptualised by the corporations as a means to remain ‘competitive but friendly’ with one another, with each individual city-state taking turns to host an annual event across a seven-year cycle. In reality, the violent races act as mindless entertainment to ensure that the masses remain suitably pacified.    

With fossil fuels long extinct, racers utilise plasma-based engine technology to supercharge their rides and achieve blistering speeds. At the start of each race, sponsors provide racers with a limited quota of electrical energy, but never enough to see them across the finish line. To encourage ‘competitive racing’ cars are fitted with energy-sapping discs that draw electricity from scattered pylons, and the wreckage of incapacitated racers. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232333/6ed08b1088659a8e511fbb3df7bbd582ecf53067.gif[/img]

[h3]Grow your entourage[/h3]

Aster inherits their father’s legendary custom [b]STAGNUM[/b], and enters Dekker’s tournament alongside childhood friend (and all-round racing superfan), [b]Quin[/b] who acts as their first teammate in the early stages of the competition. As Aster rises through the rankings they will encounter a huge cast of characters and racers to recruit to their cause. Among these is the mysterious [b]Collector[/b], a hermit who possesses forbidden knowledge of the ‘old days’ and is drawn to Aster by their uncannily familiar racing talents.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232333/02c4d2108287eac6bbcede301a0cbb7c5e55fc87.jpg[/img]

[b]RESISTOR[/b] is coming soon to Steam, make sure to wishlist and follow to keep up to date with all the latest news and information. We’ll have more to share about the project in the coming months, until next time!

Long Way Home & PQube
